result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: the controller's save_host does `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`, while the JS component does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` using the raw local categoryId, ignoring the server-serialized response. So a blank category selection will be coerced server-side but rendered with the stale/blank local value in the UI. A minor UI-consistency defect, though severity is low since the host row still displays.

record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 — After save the component sets `category` from `Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId)` instead of the server response, so the server-side blank->uncategorized coercion and any concurrent edit are invisible in the UI

adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then, on success, forces `host.category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))` rather than using the persisted value. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly coerces a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`, so if `categoryId` is null/blank (possible for new hosts; `cantSave` only checks host string, not `categoryId`), the server will save uncategorized but the UI will set `host.category` to `findById(null)`/wrong category until reload. This also bypasses any server-side changes to `category_id` reflected in the save response.
